selectedMinimalMaximalUnit.objective: Make the current resume boundary explicit and fail closed before any worker adds a blind replay path or a third mission owner.
selectedMinimalMaximalUnit.whyThisUnit: status and doctor already exist in the local bootstrap; Home Center already owns durable project/session/work truth. The missing prerequisite for deterministic resume is reconciliation between those two existing truth surfaces, not another scheduler, ledger, or Adam-specific recovery loop.

implemented: deterministic command queue execution without cloud tokens
notImplemented: mapping from local jobs to Home Center durable work-item receipts
localFortressBootstrap.crashWindow: claim() atomically moves a job from queue to running before execute() launches arbitrary command or prompt work. The result and job.finished receipt are written only after execution returns. A process/device loss after an external side effect but before those writes leaves a running job whose side-effect state is unknown.
localFortressBootstrap.replayRule: A stale running job MUST NOT be automatically moved back to queue. That would be blind replay of potentially non-idempotent external work.

implemented: pending and recent completed work refs
idempotent desired-state policy per work taskId
homeCenterDurableOwner.executionBoundary: defaultFortressWorkExecutor only executes fortress_session_probe. Other routes remain REQUESTED with an explicit no-executable-route result. There is no current adapter that binds a Home Center work item to a local fortress-bootstrap job and reconciles its receipt.

sourceLevelRecoveryTest.proves: In the fake-Firestore contract surface, a fresh Home Center server reconstructs the durable objective and work receipts from the existing Home Center owner.
sourceLevelRecoveryTest.doesNotProve: live deployment, live connector callability, or reconciliation with tools/fortress_bootstrap.py

adjacentOwnerNotToDuplicate.fact: Adam already has a separate tmux-backed --resume for Adam commissions. It is not the sovereign Home Center mission owner and must not be generalized by copy/paste into a third recovery system.

resumeMust: report its durable job id and evidence paths
look for a bound Home Center work receipt and external effect evidence
resume only after the desired state is proven unsatisfied or the action is explicitly classified replay-safe
resumeMustNot: rerun the command merely because the daemon is dead
treat Adam --resume as sovereign mission recovery

exactBlocker.statement: The repository has two legitimate but unbound truth surfaces: Home Center work/session receipts and the local Fortress queue. Until a durable binding identifies which Home Center work item owns a local job and records replay safety/effect reconciliation, a deterministic generic resume cannot safely advance stale running work.
exactBlocker.whyExecutionStopsHere: Adding a resume that simply restarts the daemon is safe for queued work, but calling that sovereign resume would falsely claim mission recovery. Requeueing running work is worse: it can duplicate side effects. Building a third ledger would duplicate an existing owner. The smallest correct prerequisite is the binding/reconciliation contract.

capabilityState.capability: deterministic sovereign resume/advance across Home Center mission truth and local Fortress execution

artifactState.purpose: durable exact blocker plus recovery fixture; this file is evidence, not the missing runtime capability

nextRealBoundary.unit: Add one narrow binding/reconciliation seam between an existing homeCenterWorkItems taskId/receipt and an existing fortress-job-v1 job id. It must classify replay safety and resolve stale running jobs from evidence before execution. Then expose resume through the existing owner rather than creating another ledger.
acceptance: a fixture for daemon-dead + stale-running + unknown-side-effect fails closed without replay
a fixture for daemon-dead + queued replay-safe job starts existing execution and preserves the same ids
status/doctor expose the binding and exact next boundary
no new mission/job authority is introduced
